summary: Implemented rich.progress open and wrap_file (module-level and Progress methods) with private _ProgressReader and _ProgressFileContext classes in rich/progress.py; added 17 tests in tests/test_progress.py, docs subsections in docs/source/progress.rst, and a CHANGELOG bullet for PR 1759. Nothing was run: no tests, mypy, black, or Python 3.6 import check. The type-ignore comments on readline, readinto, and the handle readinto call follow the spec but are unverified. The context wrapper is non-generic, so I did not add the spec's optional return-value/type-variable suppression. Changes are uncommitted.
